title: Where are you going?

english_full:
A: Morning! Have you had breakfast?

B: Morning! have eaten. Are you going to work?

A: Today is Saturday, so I don’t work.

B: Yes, today is Saturday! It's so early, where are you going?

A: I'm going to the library. I haven't read a book in a long time.
